title: geo_regions offline assets config v1.0
description: Input for `dart run geo_regions:assets`. Structures, per-country locales and catalog locales are configured independently so that adding a locale never changes structure payload selection.

profile.description: Human-readable profile name recorded in the audit report.

structures.description: Country structures bundled offline. Empty array = online-only (descriptor payload stays out of the build).

locales.description: Region name packs per country code. Keys must be a subset of structures.

catalogLocales.description: Country-catalog name packs bundled offline (small; independent of structures).
